result:
Implementation complete. Summary:

**Built:** `SigningPortalPage` at route `/sign/:sessionId`, plus `OtpVerificationModal`, `SignaturePadModal`, and `DeclineToSignModal`, matching the "Sign Document" target design (IMG-6/7/8) — green signer-status banner, OTP-gated identity verification with a 3-strike/15-minute lockout, document viewer revealed only after OTP, Draw/Type/Upload signature pad, and a decline-with-reason flow. Also added `signingSessionService.js` and five new hooks (`useSigningSession`, `useVerifyOtp`, `useResendOtp`, `useApplySignature`, `useDeclineSignature`) wired to the exact contract endpoints.

**Verified:** lint (0 warnings), build, and the full Vitest suite (76 tests, 6 new) all pass. Live browser screenshot comparison wasn't possible in this sandbox since starting a background dev server/mock backend required an approval I couldn't obtain autonomously — I noted this and the manual design comparison I did instead in `blockers`.

**Blockers recorded** in the output JSON: the inferred route path (no route was specified in the contract), client-side OTP lockout logic built from the only available response fields (`attemptsRemaining`/`lockedUntil`), the no-role-gate decision (mirroring the existing `ExternalReviewPage` pattern since dev auth headers can't represent a SIGNER identity), and the skipped live visual verification.

Output written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-SIGNING-PORTAL-PAGE-UI.json` with status `PARTIAL` (due to the unverified visual-fidelity step, not missing functionality).
